regulatory_or_exposure: Surrogate oral reference dose for cerium: median of nine other rare earth elements, 5 µg/kg bw per day (p. 3)
Fresh-weight carrot cerium reaching the median surrogate in one serving: 1.0 mg/kg (age 1 to 3 years) to 6.1 mg/kg (males 19 to 30 years) (Table 1, p. 6)
